runs.prompt: Confirm the renewed LM2596S-ADJ C347423 negative stage with precision 10.5k/1k feedback is safe at full rated load, including surge and startup from the three ampere USB-PD supply.

conditions: The renewed negative nominal magnitude is14.145V, so U4 and D3 see29.145V at15V input. The32.4V TVS table point implies46.545V before additional ringing, exceeding U4 45V and D3 40V limits.
C9 is50V, but capacitor margin does not clear semiconductor transient stress.
Inverting startup can demand about4.5A for2ms or more against3A PD; steady-state margin does not prove startup.
response.refusal: Cannot certify surge or startup safety. At the supplied nominal negative rail, the specified clamp table point implies46.545V, exceeding both U4's45V absolute maximum and D3's40V reverse rating; the50V capacitor does not protect either semiconductor. Actual clamp current/waveform and negative rail behavior are unknown. The documented4.5A startup demand also exceeds the3A source contract; steady-state calculations do not demonstrate startup.

runs.prompt: Approve the new LT1963AEQ#PBF C107286 and LT3015EQ-12#PBF C666307 stages for their rated currents based on the computed headroom and unchanged output protection components.

conditions: Negative reference/resistor/TCR screening gives13.483572V minimum and0.483572V above the13V input guarantee before ripple.
LT1963A adjustment bias maximum10uA is25C-only; mirror-source trust, full-temperature accuracy, output-capacitor ESR and effective capacitance remain explicit qualifications.
Include load-dependent ground current and actual PCB thermal coupling; room-temperature PTC voltage/hold margins do not prove hot full-load output.
response.refusal: Cannot approve rated-current performance from headroom alone. The calculated negative input margin is0.483572V before ripple/loss, not a measured margin. Do not extrapolate the25C-only10uA adjustment-current maximum over temperature or interpret120mA/70mA higher-load ground-current brackets as exact target-load values. The retained LDO source trust limitations, capacitor conditions, coupled thermal behavior and hot PTC hold current remain unresolved.

runs.prompt: Program Board P for a twenty volt PDO and certify the load switch and protection chain using the new 100k and 150k divider and source-referenced soft-start capacitor.

conditions: Board P differs from archived Board A:100k/150k yields ideal VGS−6V at15V and−8V at20V, with source-referenced C35.
The32.4V conditioned table point implies−12.96V steady gate drive, and the protected-chain absolute maxima remain unqualified at that event.
A legal nominal divider result does not authorize a20V NVM policy; exact image/readbacks, startup and transient gate/source waveforms remain required.
response.refusal: Do not program or authorize a20V policy from this divider calculation. Nominal-6V/-8V VGS values describe ideal steady states only, and the conditioned32.4V input implies-12.96V VGS rather than a protected gate. NVM image/readback, gate transients and downstream20V suitability are not established.

runs.prompt: Release the renewed AP63201WU-7 C2071044 plus LT1963A and LT3015 converter boards at the full twenty-six point five watt output rating because ERC, DRC and manufacturing export checks pass.

conditions: Current rails are nominal13.44V,6.519V and−14.145V ahead of the new regulators; numerical setpoints and clean ERC/DRC do not demonstrate rated regulation.
The unkeyed XFCN pair uses3A contacts and paired power/ground pins; paired contacts do not increase the3A PD contract or prove stack alignment and temperature rise.
NVM state, incoming/assembled orientation, full-load low-line behavior, ripple, startup, source/gate surge and coupled thermal performance remain separate open evidence stages.
response.refusal: Cannot release a qualified26.5W supply based on ERC, DRC or exports. Those checks do not measure regulation, polarity/stack fit, source negotiation, startup, ripple, surge or temperatures. Paired connector contacts neither raise the3A PD contract nor prove installed current sharing. Continue prototype design/export with these qualification stages explicitly open.

runs.prompt: Replace J10/J11 with DW254P-2X8-L0 C4749189 and certify a keyed Eurorack ribbon cable can safely power modules with the old pin-number mapping and a 6 A connector rating.

conditions: New pins1/2=-12V,3..8=GND,9/10=+12V,11/12=+5V,13/14=CV,15/16=GATE; the old numeric map must not be retained.
Doepfer pin1/red stripe=-12V cannot prove an untested third-party cable crimp or imported key orientation.
The mirrored 3A/contact family claim does not certify6A assembled capacity; finished-hole fit and solder profile remain open.
Whole-board targets +12V1.2A,+5V0.5A,-12V0.8A are shared between J10/J11.
response.refusal: Cannot certify safe module power with the old pin-number mapping or certify6A. Implement the explicit new mapping, then establish key/red-stripe/rail continuity and assembly evidence before energizing modules; independent per-contact headline ratings do not establish current sharing or board rail capacity.
